name: SEATEXT FREE Translation and Conversion Rate Boost
author: Seatext.com

sections.description:
Welcome to SEATEXT AI – the first AI for websites:

🌎 100% FREE TRANSLATIONS (no limits)
Just turn it on and AI automatically translates your entire website into 125+ languages. You can manually edit any translation if needed. Get 1TB free storage for your translated media with one-click download option. Everything is completely free forever – no word limits, no page limits!

🤖 AI SALES BOOSTER
Using the same A/B testing approach as Amazon.com, Seatext AI creates multiple versions of your text and automatically finds which ones sell better/have better conversion rate through A/B testing. The system continuously tests and improves your content, typically increasing sales by 35% within 3 months. All optimization happens automatically and is completely free!

🛡️ SMART GDPR COOKIES
We created the world’s smallest cookie popup that actually doesn’t hurt your conversion rate. Once a user consents on any website with Seatext AI installed, the AI remembers their preferences across all websites. For many visitors, based on location or previous consent, you won’t need a popup at all! Free forever with no limits.

📱 MOBILE OPTIMIZATION
Most websites make a crucial mistake – using the same long desktop text for mobile users. Our AI automatically rewrites your content to be perfectly readable on mobile screens. It continuously A/B tests different versions to find what works best, improving your mobile conversion rates automatically.

🎯 AI PERSONALIZATION
Connect your CRM, email database, or external data sources like clay.com or cohere.com and ask GPT to create a prompt for each of your potential clients. Then give these prompts to Seatext AI to rewrite your page for each prospect. Get personalized links for every customer with just one click – perfect for ABM, targeted campaigns, and cold email.

🛍️ AI FOR WOOCOMMERCE
Transform your online store with AI-powered product descriptions that actually sell. Our system creates 10+ variants of each product description and automatically A/B tests them to find the highest-converting version. Plus get complete translation of your store into 125 languages. Free forever!

Truly free – No limits! Unlike Weglot, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, GTranslate, Loco Translate, MultilingualPress, Babble, ConveyThis, Transposh, WooCommerce Multilingual, and others.

3.0.7

  • More languages support

3.0.5

  • Optimized plugin tags for better WordPress repository visibility

3.0.4

So many changes – translations, two new products

3.0.3

  • Improved AI translation accuracy with enhanced context understanding.
  • Added support for additional languages in the translation engine.
  • Fixed bugs related to WooCommerce product page translation.
  • Updated compatibility with the latest version of WordPress (6.6.2).
  • Enhanced performance for faster translation loading times.
